further_notes: Windows 页文件读取效率按 storage.effective_gbps 估算；写入按 read 的 0.8 估（含写放大 1.0-1.5 由用户磁盘型号决定，可在高级选项调整）。
mmap 读取且数据在页缓存时，实际速度 = RAM 带宽（effective_gbps）。--fast-disk 会把权重移到页缓存，因此 RAM 不足时表现为可回收而非 OOM。
ComfyUI 启动日志里的 "Enabled pinned memory 25212.0" 是预留池（≈总 RAM 的 40%），按需提交、并非立即占用；估算器只按流式缓冲计 RAM。
--fast-disk 把权重放到页缓存（文件页，只读、可回收），内存不足时表现为频繁从 SSD 读回而不是页文件写入；默认模式则是匿名副本，超额会真实落盘。
further_notes_en: Windows pagefile reads are estimated from storage.effective_gbps; writes are estimated at 0.8x read (write amplification of 1.0-1.5 depends on your drive model and is adjustable in the advanced options).

When reading via mmap and the data is in page cache, actual speed = RAM bandwidth (effective_gbps). --fast-disk moves weights into page cache, so insufficient RAM shows up as reclaimable memory rather than OOM.

The "Enabled pinned memory 25212.0" line in the ComfyUI startup log is a reservation pool (≈40% of total RAM) committed on demand, not used immediately; the estimator only counts streaming buffers as RAM.

--fast-disk puts weights in page cache (file pages, read-only, reclaimable); when memory runs short this shows up as frequent reads back from the SSD instead of pagefile writes; the default mode keeps anonymous copies, and overcommit really does hit disk.
